synthetic_lenti_ef1a.gb.source: Generated for BT5 by a seeded script (numpy default_rng(20260827)); not derived from any real plasmid or third-party map, so it carries no upstream licence.
synthetic_lenti_ef1a.gb.why_not_a_real_addgene_map: The fixture must exercise specific geometry -- an origin-spanning join(), an annotated 5'UTR, an intron outside the CDS, and two identical LTRs -- and must be an INDEPENDENT parse target rather than something bt5.vector's own writer produced. A hand-specified file gives all of that with no redistribution question.

layout.intron: 721..800 -- inside the 5' region, NOT inside the CDS
layout.3' LTR: 1521..1770 -- byte-identical to the 5' LTR, a genuine 250 bp direct repeat

synthetic_lenti_ef1a.gb.notes: The two LTRs are the same 250 bp on purpose: they are what SegmentKind.WHITELISTED_REPEAT exists for, and no codon choice can remove them.

real_lenti_pFTMGW_EF177827.gb.kind: real lentiviral transfer vector (unmodified public deposit)
real_lenti_pFTMGW_EF177827.gb.vector: pFTMGW -- a FUGW-derived third-generation lentiviral transfer vector (CMV-driven 5' LTR, Psi, splice donor, cPPT, MCS, eGFP, WPRE, 3' LTR, ColE1 origin)
real_lenti_pFTMGW_EF177827.gb.source: NCBI GenBank, fetched via E-utilities efetch (db=nuccore, rettype=gb). The bytes are the unmodified deposit -- BT5 added no annotation and changed no coordinate.
real_lenti_pFTMGW_EF177827.gb.license: Public domain (NCBI GenBank sequence records are not copyrighted)
real_lenti_pFTMGW_EF177827.gb.features: 12 features, 6 kinds (source, repeat_region x2, misc_feature x6, gene, CDS, rep_origin) -- the messy real-world annotation (misc_feature soup, real LTRs, real WPRE, a quirky /transl_table=11 on the eGFP CDS) that issue #74 wants and the synthetic fixtures smooth over.
real_lenti_pFTMGW_EF177827.gb.why_a_real_map: Issue #74 / PLAN #1: the synthetic fixtures are sufficient for coordinate-model CORRECTNESS but not for annotation QUALITY (G2). This is a genuine, publication-backed, named lentiviral transfer vector, verified to round-trip losslessly through bt5.vector (sequence, topology and every feature location/key/qualifier preserved; writer idempotent).
real_lenti_pFTMGW_EF177827.gb.why_ncbi_not_addgene: Issue #74 named Addgene and proposed keeping the map OUT of the repo behind an env var, because an Addgene-authored map carries redistribution ambiguity. Sourcing the same class of vector from an NCBI GenBank deposit -- public domain -- removes that ambiguity, so the fixture can be COMMITTED and round-trip-checked in-repo instead of hidden behind an env var.
real_lenti_pFTMGW_EF177827.gb.what_it_does_not_carry: No annotated 5'UTR feature and no origin-spanning join(): an unmodified linearized deposit has neither (the 5'UTR is implicit, and no feature wraps the depositor's chosen base 1). That geometry is deliberately covered by synthetic_lenti_ef1a.gb; hand-adding it here would corrupt the map's value as an independent, unmodified parse target. PLAN #1's origin-spanning bar remains satisfied by the synthetic fixture; this fixture closes the annotation-quality gap.
real_lenti_pFTMGW_EF177827.gb.notes: Issue #74 item 2 (a @pytest.mark.slow design() end-to-end round-trip test) lives in the design/vector lane, not the data lane; it remains open on #74. This fixture was verified to round-trip losslessly out-of-band.
